📖 How to use

  1. Pick the date (defaults to today) and a category.
  2. Enter minutes and press Log time.
  3. See the day's total and per-category breakdown.
  4. Check the 7-day bar chart for trends.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where is my data stored?

In this browser's localStorage. Your entries stay on your device and are restored when you return.

Can I log by app category?

Yes — pick a category like Social, Work, Entertainment, Games, News or Other for each entry.

What does the 7-day chart show?

The chart always covers the last 7 days ending today, with total minutes per day.
